item.title: Massachusetts police searching for wife of cop found dead at home
item.description: Police in Massachusetts are looking for Karen Solomon, a woman whose husband was found dead at their home. Police have said she is "presumed to be armed and dangerous." CBS News' Lilia Luciano has more.

item.title: More than 70 million Americans in South facing extreme heat as temperatures go above 100
item.description: More than 70 million Americans are facing extreme heat across the South, with temperatures climbing well above 100 in some areas. CBS News' Jason Allen has more.

item.title: Manhunt on for Massachusetts wife of police officer found dead
item.description: A search is underway in Massachusetts for a 58-year-old woman considered armed and dangerous whose police officer husband was found dead Tuesday. Lilia Luciano has the latest developments.

item.title: Moderna stock surges as melanoma vaccine trial shows "landmark moment"
item.description: Moderna and Merck announced study results that reflect a "landmark moment" in treatment for one of the deadliest forms of skin cancer.

item.title: Experimental melanoma vaccine shows promising results
item.description: An experimental melanoma vaccine could reduce the risk of the cancer returning or spreading for some high-risk patients. It's personalized for each patient and optimized using artificial intelligence. Dr. Jon LaPook has more details.

item.title: Trump pauses tariffs on Canada for 3 days amid "very good deal"
item.description: President Trump says he's putting a three-day pause on Canadian tariffs as the two countries work to finalize what he called a "very good deal" that would benefit farmers. CBS News' Olivia Rinaldi has more.

item.title: Psychologist who treated Lindsay Clancy testifies at trial
item.description: Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts woman on trial for killing her three children in 2023, has pleaded not guilty, citing her own struggle with postpartum psychosis. On Wednesday, a psychologist who treated Clancy after the killings testified about her state of mind the night of the tragedy. Shanelle Kaul reports.

item.title: Prince Harry and Meghan moving back to U.K.
item.description: The couple said in January 2020 that they would be stepping away from "senior" royal roles​ and were working to become financially independent from the royal family.

item.title: Prince Harry and Meghan moving back to the U.K. after 6 years in California
item.description: Prince Harry and Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, are moving back to the U.K. six years after stepping back from their royal duties to start a new life in California, their representatives confirmed.

item.title: Trump announces "crushing economic operation" on Iran as talks in limbo
item.description: President Trump said Wednesday the U.S. might return to negotiations with Iran eventually, but said currently "the situation is so good."

item.title: Trump flaunts White House improvement projects
item.description: White House reporters were called to the South Lawn Wednesday for a surprise tour of some of President Trump's favorite home improvement projects around the White House. Nancy Cordes reports.

item.title: Woman told House panel that Gomez sexually assaulted her, attorneys say
item.description: The California Democrat said Monday that he "made personal mistakes outside my marriage" and that his "actions were consensual in nature."

item.title: Americans fighting brutal heat coast to coast
item.description: Coast-to-coast heat is scorching the southern U.S., with the temperature in Charleston, South Carolina, with a heat index of 113 degrees, while California's Death Valley was seeing a high of 118 degrees. Jason Allen reports from Phoenix, Arizona, which is also experiencing triple-digit heat.

item.title: 5 Americans among 7 killed in luxury safari helicopter crash in Kenya
item.description: A luxury safari helicopter crashed in Kenya with no survivors, according to investigators there. Five of the seven people killed were Americans. Imtiaz Tyab reports.

item.title: Breaking down Angie Nixon's Florida primary win over Alex Vindman
item.description: CBS News Miami investigative reporter Jim DeFede joins "The Takeout" to discuss Tuesday's Florida primaries and Angie Nixon's upset win over Alex Vindman.

item.title: He spied for the U.S. in the war on terror. Now ICE wants to deport him.
item.description: The Trump administration is trying to deport a self-described CIA spy who won permission to live in the U.S. by helping convict terrorists.

item.title: Publix frozen blueberry recall upgraded to highest health risk level
item.description: Recalled frozen blueberries and mixed berries that could be contaminated with E. coli pose the most severe category of health risk, according to the FDA.

item.title: Beagles get first taste of freedom after relocation from controversial breeding facility
item.description: Thousands of beagles that were bred for medical research are getting a new life after being released from Ridglan Farms, a Wisconsin facility that bred dogs for biomedical research. Adam Yamaguchi reports.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy testimony ends early due to "unforeseen circumstance"
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's trial continued Wednesday in Massachusetts, though testimony for the day ended earlier than expected.

item.title: What to make of Trump's latest comments on Iran as he says talks could continue "at some point"
item.description: President Trump on Wednesday said the U.S. could return to negotiations with Iran "at some point," but expressed general satisfaction with the state of the war. CBS News' Nancy Cordes and Aaron MacLean have more.

item.title: 5 Americans among 7 people killed in Kenya helicopter crash
item.description: NBCUniversal said its Florida-based journalist, José Alberto Suárez, was among those killed in the crash.

item.title: 2 members of Tennessee college cycling team killed in highway collision
item.description: Two members of the Milligan University cycling team were killed, and several more injured, in a collision with a vehicle on a rural highway in eastern Tennessee Wednesday morning.

item.title: 5 Americans among 7 killed in Kenya safari helicopter crash
item.description: Seven people, including five Americans, were killed Wednesday when a helicopter taking tourists on a safari crashed in a remote part of northern Kenya. CBS News senior foreign correspondent Imtiaz Tyab has the latest.

item.title: Dr. Oz on Trump and prescription drug prices, skin cancer vaccine trial
item.description: Dr. Mehmet Oz, administrator of the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, joins "The Takeout" to discuss the Trump administration's touting of lower prescription drug prices. He also comments on a promising skin cancer vaccine trial.

item.title: Factors that led to Angie Nixon's primary win over Alex Vindman
item.description: Angie Nixon pulled off an upset Tuesday night against Alex Vindman in Florida's Democratic Senate primary, but how surprising was it? Major Garrett shares his thoughts.

item.title: NASA's Swift telescope will plunge toward Earth after rescue mission called off
item.description: The mission to save NASA's sinking space telescope has been called off, dooming the telescope to a fiery reentry later this year.

item.title: Penn State frat brothers charged with running cocaine trafficking ring
item.description: Two Penn State fraternities are at the center of a cocaine trafficking ring bust, leading to charges against 14 people, authorities said.

item.title: National debt tops $40 trillion after doubling in under 10 years
item.description: Federal debt has mounted amid tax cuts and trillions in pandemic spending, adding to the nation's interest payments.

item.title: Trump pausing 50% tariffs on some Canadian goods as deal being finalized
item.description: President Trump said Tuesday that the U.S. and Canada have reached a last-minute agreement to pause the 50% tariffs.

item.title: Moving pillowcase leads to discovery of reptiles in car seized at border
item.description: Federal officers found a moving pillowcase in a car that was seized at the U.S.-Mexico border. A collection of stolen exotic reptiles was inside.
